review.appReviewNotes:
Paste this text into App Store Connect > App Review Information > Notes.

WHAT THE APP IS
AliStore POS is the point-of-sale application of AliStore, a retail operations platform for electronics stores. A cashier working for a subscribing store looks up catalog items, builds a sale, prepares split tender, receives a receipt issued by our server, follows the state of the shift and reviews the history of till operations. Access is role-based and each store provisions accounts for its own cashiers, so a cashier account is required to use the app.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Accounts are provisioned by each store from its ERP back office, so the app has no self-service registration by design. We created a dedicated review cashier account for this submission and filled it into the Demo Account fields above.
The app opens on a sign-in screen with two fields, labelled in Russian: the first is the user name, the second is the matching sign-in credential. Enter exactly the two values from the Demo Account fields and tap the sign-in button. There is no one-time code step, no SMS, and nothing you need to request from us. Two-factor authentication is switched off on this account.
The account is loaded with representative non-production review data (an open review shift plus sample catalog and sales data), so nothing you do in review affects a live store. If the account ever stops working during review, message us and we will re-issue it immediately.

WHAT TO EXPECT
The full sale workflow is reviewable on the device alone. External receipt printers and payment terminals are optional certified hardware used in stores; they are not needed to evaluate the software, and the app falls back to an on-screen receipt without them. Sales, shift open and close, and every money movement are written to an append-only audit ledger scoped to the review store. The app does not track users and ships a privacy manifest declaring NSPrivacyTracking=false.

CONTACT
Support: https://ali.kg/support. We monitor App Review messages continuously during review.

Кассир магазина находит товары, формирует продажу, готовит раздельную оплату, получает чек с сервера, контролирует состояние смены и просматривает историю операций.
